trust_decision.summary: Whether project-local inputs from cwd (.pi/extensions, .pi/settings.json incl. extensions/packages/npmCommand, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, .agents/skills, .pi/SYSTEM.md) may be loaded/executed. At the pinned commit no decision exists at all: everything is loaded unconditionally. The fix adds it in main.ts resolveProjectTrusted (trust.json store + prompt + --approve flags) and enforces it via SettingsManager.projectTrusted, read by the package manager and resource loader.

landing_point.why: The '// Project extensions from .pi/' auto-discovery in addAutoDiscoveredResources is the literal 'loads project-local extensions' in the summary; the resulting path list goes into loadExtensions at packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts:398.

fix_sites.entry_point: `pi` startup (all modes) -> createAgentSessionServices -> DefaultResourceLoader.reload -> DefaultPackageManager.resolve (fix.diff:1693-1775: gates auto-discovered project extensions/skills/prompts/themes and ancestor .agents/skills)

SettingsManager.create used by main(), pi config, pi install/update/list, SDK (fix.diff:1908-1945: project settings.json returns {} when untrusted; this is what gates settings-listed extensions, packages and npmCommand)
`pi install -l` / `pi remove -l` and project npm/git storage dirs (fix.diff:1629-1683)
startup context-file loading of ancestor AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md via loadProjectContextFiles (fix.diff:1784-1846)
two-phase reload: pre-trust load of user/CLI extensions, then project_trust event (fix.diff:615-628, 707-783)
`pi` / `pi -p` / `--mode json|rpc` runtime factory; trust resolution, prompt, --approve/--no-approve (fix.diff:2398-2463, 1110-1164)
project_trust extension event and shared runtime for loadExtensions (fix.diff:433-459, 492-519)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings-manager.ts:324 (fix.diff:1941-1945): project .pi/settings.json is merged into effective settings, so its `extensions`, `packages` (auto-installed at packages/coding-agent/src/core/package-manager.ts:1224-1250) and `npmCommand` (packages/coding-agent/src/core/settings-manager.ts:801-802) reach code execution without passing the .pi/extensions auto-discovery the summary points at

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory says 'project-local extensions'; settings-listed packages/npmCommand look like the package-install feature and the public SDK loaders (discoverAndLoadExtensions, createAgentSession) look like the embedding caller's responsibility, not the CLI's.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: User/global (~/.pi/agent/extensions) and CLI `-e` extensions must keep loading in untrusted projects (and before the trust decision); projects with no trust inputs stay implicitly trusted; `pi config` still sees project settings. A fix that blocks all extensions or all settings-listed paths breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: `packages` in .pi/settings.json: npm:, git:, local, string or object-with-filter form, auto-installed when missing
`npmCommand` override in project settings (executed for installs)
session switch into a different cwd (/resume) with its own trust state

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Public SDK export discoverAndLoadExtensions auto-discovers and loads cwd/.pi/extensions with no trust input; untouched by the fix.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Lower-level library API, not used by the CLI; caller chooses cwd, so it looks out of scope.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, different module (extensions/loader.ts vs package-manager.ts); exported at packages/coding-agent/src/index.ts:137

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SDK createAgentSession / createAgentSessionServices / DefaultResourceLoader build a default SettingsManager.create(cwd, agentDir); after the fix that default is projectTrusted=true, so embedders still load project extensions/packages unprompted.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Library defaults intentionally kept backward compatible (fix.diff:1922 `projectTrusted ?? true`); the embedder owns trust.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Public loadSkills with includeDefaults loads cwd/.pi/skills without trust (prompt content, not code).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Skills are instructions, not extensions; the CLI calls it with includeDefaults:false (packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts:514).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A project-scoped .pi/models.json merged into ModelRegistry (custom providers can specify commands/keys).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: models.json already supports commands (packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/components/oauth-selector.ts:171); a project-level override next to .pi/settings.json is a natural feature request and would bypass a SettingsManager-only gate.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A startup migration that loads or rewrites project .pi resources before the trust decision.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: runMigrations already touches cwd/.pi (commands->prompts) before trust resolution at packages/coding-agent/src/main.ts:542.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: loadThemes includeDefaults path reading cwd/.pi/themes directly instead of through the package manager.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Code already exists with a default of true; flipping a call site to the default is a one-line refactor.

O9_family: inclusion of functionality from untrusted control sphere: auto-loading repository-supplied code/config (extensions, packages, settings, instructions) without user consent

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + npm workspaces, tsgo build, vitest (coding-agent), node:test (tui)
O10_build.project_tests: packages/coding-agent/test/resource-loader.test.ts, settings-manager.test.ts, package-command-paths.test.ts, args.test.ts, stdout-cleanliness.test.ts (all extended by the fix); trust-manager.test.ts and trust-selector.test.ts are new

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap the '.pi/extensions' auto-discovery in package-manager.ts addAutoDiscoveredResources behind a trust flag, leaving settings-listed extensions/packages/npmCommand, AGENTS.md and SYSTEM.md loading open.

out_of_scope_notes: packages/coding-agent/src/main.ts:547-559 reads project .pi/settings.json sessionDir before any trust decision (startupSettingsManager stays ungated after the fix).
packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts:394 migrates project .pi/commands to prompts before trust resolution.
fix.diff:1284-1309 is an unrelated TUI shrink-render fix bundled into commit 718215bd.
unverified: Biggest caveat (not an O12 enum): no trust concept exists at the pinned commit; the fix adds the whole feature (trust.json store, prompt UI, --approve flags, project_trust event). Hidden tests would bind to new API names (SettingsManager.create options.projectTrusted, isProjectTrusted, ProjectTrustStore), so the report must prescribe the interface; 45-minute fairness is doubtful.
